text.text: Production `payment-service` is failing on multiple fronts: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion is causing `DB_CONN_TIMEOUT` and `PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved`, the pod is crash-looping with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` and `OOMKilled`, and `api-gateway` is returning repeated `502`/`504` timeouts for `POST /api/v1/payments`. Affected services include `payment-service`, `postgres-primary`, `api-gateway`, `kubelet`/`kubernetes`, and `deployment-controller`; `auth-service` and `redis-cache` also have a separate P1 auth timeout issue causing `401`s. Overall severity is P1 with major user impact: payment requests are failing, the payment deployment is down to `1/6` available replicas, and authentication is intermittently blocking profile access. The single most critical next step is to immediately pause or roll back the `payment-service` rollout and shed `POST /api/v1/payments` traffic to stop the cascading DB, OOM, and gateway failures.

*Issues Identified:*
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `payment-service, postgres-primary, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, kubelet, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *NETWORK_ERROR* on `api-gateway, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 90%)
• *AUTH_ERROR* on `auth-service, redis-cache, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 96%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `deployment-controller, payment-service, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 84%)
